thread:
Talia M: quick note from design sync — proposing a "staged-hedge+swap" flow that reduces cache duplication while still giving rapid protection for high-SLO tenants. sharing a tiny flow and open questions.

Talia M: flow sketch: 1) seed-phase: sample 1% mirrored requests (no writes) for 1 hour; 2) hedge-phase: probabilistic hedges up to 20% for prefixes that show tail spikes; 3) weight-shift: move traffic incrementally to backup; 4) hard-swap: enforced after 3 contiguous windows above threshold.

Devon P: sounds reasonable. Q: what metrics define "tail spike"? p99 increase vs baseline? absolute p95? tenant-normalized delta?

Ravi S: prefer tenant-normalized delta + min-reqs gate. small tenants should use aggregated signals or be opt-in for auto-swap.

Talia M: agreed. we'll require min_requests=250/window and use score = max((p95/baseline_p95), (err_rate/baseline_err))*100 to map into actions.

Devon P: cache impact: when hedging, do speculative reads only (no writing backup cache). if hedges hit often, emit prewarm hint for that prefix to control-plane.

Ravi S: telemetry: emit event tags: decision=seed|hedge|shift|swap, reason=latency|errors|quality, sample_trace=true for 1/500 or 1/50 during swap windows. ops panel should show recent decisions per-tenant.

Talia M: safety: hysteresis windows to prevent oscillation, and a 30m cooldown after auto-swap. manual overrides via Console allowed.

Devon P: test plan: sim with mixed-tenancy + cold prefix bursts and validate that mirrored seed doesn't double-write and that prewarm hints eventually reduce hedging.

ops-bot: :white_check_mark: RFC opened: "staged-hedge-swap: draft" (https://git.internal/r/4290)

Talia M: thanks — i'll open the RFC draft and assign reviewers.
